| `content`    | `{fields?: Array<object>, source?: object, link?: object, hideEmpty?: boolean, emptyText?: string}` |          | `\{\}`  | The widget configuration. - `fields` — the entries, in order. Each is `{ path, label?, as?, format?, map?, itemPath?, parts?, separator?, route?, variant?, variantMap?, colorMap?, icon?, copy?, reveal?, text?, title?, subtitle?, initialsPath?, tone? }`. `as` is `row` (default when `label` or `icon` is set), `title`, `line`, `text` (a line in the normal ink), `lead` (an icon tile or initials beside `title` and `subtitle`) or `pill`. A row's `format` may also be `email`, `phone` or `url` (a link) or `masked` (the last four characters; `reveal: true` adds Show). `copy: true` adds a copy button; `icon` replaces the label. A part may be `{ text }`, a constant; a `line` or `text` entry without `path` or `parts` shows its `text`. `resolve: { register, schema, labelField? }` on an entry or a part turns a value that is a reference (an id, or a list of ids) into the label of the referenced object (`labelField`, else `title`, then `name`): the case type or status of a task shows its name, not its uuid. The ids are fetched once per register and schema through the object store and shared by every facts widget on the page; the entry stays empty until its label is known, and when no label can be read. A resolved value works as a pill too: `map` is applied to the resolved label, and `variantMap` / `colorMap` look the tone up by the value of `resolve.toneField` on the referenced object when that is set (a status named by its `name`, coloured by its `state`), then by the resolved label, then by the stored value. - `action` — an action drawn as a button under the facts; `headerAction` — one drawn in the card header (reported through the `header` event). `format` is `text` (default), `date` (board short date), `date-long` (always with the year), `list` (an array joined by ", ", each item read at `itemPath`) or `currency` (a money amount in the reader's language, "€ 1.234,50": the code in `currency`, else the record's `currencyField`, else the app's reporting currency, else EUR; `decimals` defaults to 2). `map` turns a raw value into a label (translated). `parts` (on a `line`) lists paths, or `{ path, label?, format? }`, joined by `separator` (default " · "); empty parts are dropped. - `source` — `{ register, schema, id }` or `{ url }`; omitted = the current object. - `link` — `{ label, route? \| href? }` at the foot. - `hideEmpty` — drop an entry whose value is empty (default true). - `emptyText` — shown when no entry has a value. |
